reviewSource.reviewerReason: Prominent pseudo-lettering dominates the candidate; the city/skyline sign identity is weak and hanging/mounting geometry is malformed. Replacement must remove all text-like marks, establish an unmistakable abstract city/cloud sign silhouette, and use coherent rigid wall mounting.

variants.optimizerInput: Neon City Sign, Wall Decor, Tier 4, Cloud Pop. Create ONE coherent physical wall-mounted neon city sign with a translucent cloud-shaped acrylic backplate and an unmistakable abstract skyline silhouette made only from geometric building forms and luminous tubes—NO letters, glyphs, pseudo-writing, numbers, symbols, or text-like marks anywhere. Use brushed-metal standoffs, four clearly connected mounting points, a hidden rear cable channel, crisp cyan/soft-pink/white light tubing, beveled acrylic thickness, and restrained controlled bloom. Show the full sign centered and completely inside frame in a clean three-quarter product view against a simple neutral wall plane. The skyline/cloud silhouette must remain readable at small Store-card scale. No dangling wires, broken supports, floating parts, floor base, logos, labels, or background clutter.

Neon City Sign, Wall Decor, Tier 4, Cloud Pop. Design a premium sculptural wall fixture with stacked cloud-shaped frosted acrylic layers framing a bold geometric city skyline relief. Use five to seven large rectangular building masses with stepped rooflines and edge-lit cyan/magenta/white accents, with no windows that resemble letters and absolutely NO typography, pseudo-text, glyphs, numbers, logos, or signs-within-the-sign. Make the mounting construction explicit: rigid metal rear plate, short standoffs, visible fasteners at four corners, clean concealed cable exit, and believable wall contact/cast shadow. Keep one dominant city/cloud silhouette, centered with generous negative space, fully contained in frame, crisp at Store-card size, and lit with controlled Cloud Pop glow rather than excessive bloom. No malformed hanging geometry, no loose wires, no floor contact, no unrelated props.
